issues.description: Program entry symbol differs between template and solution: template_repository/pixel.asm declares the program entry as 'global main' (line 30) while solution_repository/pixel.asm declares 'global _start' (line 14). This naming inconsistency can confuse students about which symbol to implement/export and may affect how the program is linked/run with the provided Makefile (the build assumes the usual C runtime startup that calls 'main'). The mismatch is purely a naming/entry-point contradiction (not an intentional TODO) and can lead to linking/runtime surprises.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the exported entry symbol consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution's declaration from 'global _start' to 'global main' (or remove the stray 'global _start') so the solution matches the template and the provided Makefile. Alternatively, if _start is intended, update the template and Makefile to use _start and ensure a proper '_start' label and runtime setup exist in the solution; document the intended entry behavior in the problem statement.
